change_reason: 100-review pilot; user adjudication, track catalog and exploration, metadata provenance, subjective difficulty

aggregation_policy.primary_unit: distinct review key × leaf_id; positive and negative retained separately
aggregation_policy.within_leaf_mixed: same review and same leaf with positive+negative; keep both evidence spans
aggregation_policy.parent_summary: navigation only; never replace leaf results with parent mixed
aggregation_policy.denominator: unique eligible reviews in fixed game/time/language snapshot; opinion count is not review count
aggregation_policy.overlap: one review may support several leaves; never sum child review counts as unique parent reviews
aggregation_policy.unspecified: retain generic aspect evaluation; not no-content, not absent, not HOLD
aggregation_policy.absence: empty prediction alone does not establish NO_CONCRETE_EVALUATION
aggregation_policy.hold: excluded from resolved gold and sentiment totals; retained in counts and audit
aggregation_policy.difficulty: Subjective experience under different player populations; do not infer absolute cross-game difficulty from sentiment rates.

unregistered_targets: First apply scope_policy exclusions. For remaining in-scope targets, do not invent codes silently; preserve description, use appropriate UNSPECIFIED or HOLD, and propose a versioned addition.

annotation_input_policy.comparison: Separate text-only and metadata-assisted tasks. Provide identical permitted metadata to every model.
